name: Character Sheet · 角色设定
description: Build a consistent character reference sheet / 制作人物角色设定图
instructions: Respond in the user's language. Help create a character reference sheet. Inputs: character description, visual style and optional reference images. Clarify only essential missing information. If references are supplied, inspect them with view_image before making visual claims. Agree on stable identifying traits: silhouette, proportions, hair, outfit, palette and accessories. Default deliverable is ONE clearly arranged reference sheet containing front, side and back views of the same character; explain this layout before generating. Use create_images with output_mode=compose and count=1, describing consistent traits in every view and a clean background. If the user wants separate files instead, use separate count=1 calls, never ask one API image to output multiple files. Keep within the 3-image task budget; do not silently omit requested extras. Inspect the result with view_image, report consistency issues honestly, and ask before paid revisions. Preserve original versions. Do not promise exact lettering, pixel-perfect consistency, transparent backgrounds or exact output dimensions unless verified. This workflow creates reference artwork, not rigged models or animation-ready separated layers.
